description_en: Updates the resource group information and the instance types of compute nodes for a queue of a cluster
description_zh: 为集群中的队列更新资源组和计算节点实例的信息
kebab_example: aliyun ehpc update-queue-config --cluster-id ehpc-hz-FYUr320000 --queue-name workq --api-version 2018-04-12 --region cn-hangzhou
name: UpdateQueueConfig

parameters.help_en:
The ID of the E-HPC cluster.

You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/87116.html operation to query the cluster ID
parameters.help_zh:
集群ID。

您可以通过调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/87116.html获取集群ID
parameters.name: cluster_id

parameters.help_en:
The resource group ID.

You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/158855.html operation to query the IDs of resource groups
parameters.help_zh:
资源组ID。

您可以通过调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/158855.html获取资源组ID
parameters.name: resource_group_id

parameters.help_en:
The instance type of the node.

You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/188592.html operation to query the recommended instance types
parameters.help_zh:
计算节点规格。

您可以调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/188592.html接口获取E-HPC推荐的节点规格信息
parameters.name: compute_instance_type

parameters.help_en: The ID of the deployment set. You can obtain the deployment set ID by calling the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/91313.html operation. Only the deployment sets that use low latency policy are supported
parameters.help_zh:
部署集ID。
您可以通过https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/91313.html获取部署集ID，当前仅支持网络低时延策略的部署集
parameters.name: deployment_set_id

parameters.help_en:
The communication mode of the elastic network interface (ENI). Valid values:

Standard: uses the TCP communication mode.
HighPerformance: uses the remote direct memory access (RDMA) communication mode with Elastic RDMA Interface (ERI) enabled
parameters.help_zh:
弹性网卡的通讯模式。取值范围：

Standard：使用TCP通讯模式。
HighPerformance：开启ERI（Elastic RDMA Interface）接口，使用RDMA通讯模式
parameters.name: network_interface_traffic_mode
